agentId.description: ID of the agent on whose behalf the message was sent (only in messages sent by an agent).

agentName.description: Agent’s name as displayed to the visitor. Only in the messages sent by an agent.

agentUserpic.description: Only set if the agent has uploaded a profile picture.

bcc.description: An array containing details of the blind carbon copy (BCC) recipients (applicable only to messages in email threads).

cc.description: An array containing details of the carbon copy (CC) recipients (applicable only to messages in email threads).

forwardedToSourceStatus.description: Status of the message forwarding to the source.

from.description: An object containing details about the email sender (applicable only to messages in email threads).

html.description: The HTML content of the message.

id.description: Message ID. It can be used for further manipulations with the message.

isBot.description: `true` for automated messages generated by an AI bot.

isMissedByVisitor.description: `true` for unread agent’s messages in finished chats.

isTrigger.description: `true` for automatic messages from “Targeted chats & triggers” and API (https://developers.brevo.com/docs/javascript-api-reference#sendautomessage)

rawUnsafeHtml.description: Unescaped HTML content of the message (may include unsafe HTML).

receivedFrom.description: In two-way integrations, messages sent via REST API can be marked with receivedFrom property and then filtered out when received in a webhook to avoid infinite loop.

replyTo.description: An object containing details of the reply-to email address (applicable only to messages in email threads).

sourceMessageId.description: The ID of the message assigned by the integration source.

subject.description: The subject line of the email message (only for messages sent to email threads).

text.description: Message text or name of the attached file

to.description: An array containing details of the recipients (applicable only to messages in email threads).

type.description: `"agent"` for agents’ messages, `"visitor"` for visitors’ messages.

isSentViaJsApi.description: ‘`true` if the message was sent via JavaScript API.’

messageType.description: The type of message content (e.g. for integration-specific message types).

isForward.description: ‘`true` if the message is a forwarded message.’

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the file.

inlineId.description: The ID of the inline file.

size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

imageInfo.description: Image information (only present for image files).

isAllowedFileType.description: Whether the file extension is allowed for download.

width.description: Width of the image in pixels.

height.description: Height of the image in pixels.

ConversationsMessageAttachmentsItemsImag.description: Image information (only present for image files).
ConversationsMessageAttachmentsItemsImag.title: ConversationsMessageAttachmentsItemsImageInfo

isImage.description: Whether the file is an image.

isSticker.description: Whether the file is a sticker.

inlineId.description: The ID of the inline file.

imageInfo.description: Image info, present when the file is an image.

isAllowedFileType.description: Whether the file extension is allowed for download.

width.description: Width of the image in pixels.

height.description: Height of the image in pixels.

ConversationsMessageFileImageInfo.description: Image info, present when the file is an image.
ConversationsMessageFileImageInfo.title: ConversationsMessageFileImageInfo

ConversationsMessageForwardedToSourceSta.description: Status of the message forwarding to the source.
ConversationsMessageForwardedToSourceSta.title: ConversationsMessageForwardedToSourceStatus

ConversationsMessageFrom.title: ConversationsMessageFrom

ConversationsMessageReplyTo.description: An object containing details of the reply-to email address (applicable only to messages in email threads).
ConversationsMessageReplyTo.title: ConversationsMessageReplyTo
